en.headline: Scaffolding worker dies after falling with dog-arm boom in Sham Shui Po
en.dek: A man in his 50s fell from rooftop scaffolding at Yu Chau Street on Friday morning and was certified dead at Caritas Medical Centre; the Labour Department is investigating.
body: A scaffolding worker died after falling from a rooftop at a tenement building in Sham Shui Po on Friday morning, according to police and labour sources.

Police received a report at about 11.39am that a male worker had fallen at 228-230 Yu Chau Street. Emergency crews found him unconscious on a platform roughly seven floors below and took him to Caritas Medical Centre, where he was certified dead at 12.41pm.

Initial accounts said the worker, reported as a local man aged about 50, was wearing a safety harness attached to a dog-arm boom while working on rooftop scaffolding when the boom and the worker fell together. Colleagues at the scene raised the alarm.

The Labour Department said it is investigating the fatal industrial accident. Construction industry representatives noted that the harness may have been attached to the boom rather than an independent lifeline fixed to the building structure, and that ageing concrete or thick render on older buildings can weaken the hold of expansion bolts.
The case has been classified as an industrial accident. Union figures said it was the 19th construction fatality of the year and the second involving suspended scaffolding work.

zh.headline: 深水埗搭棚工連狗臂架墮下身亡 勞工處調查
zh.dek: 一名約50歲男工今早在汝州街唐樓天台棚架工作時連同狗臂架墮下，送明愛醫院後不治，勞工處正調查事故原因。
body: 深水埗發生致命工業意外，一名搭棚工人今早由唐樓天台墮下，送院後不治。
警方上午約11時39分接報，指汝州街228至230號有男工人從高處墮下，倒臥約七層樓下的平台。救援人員到場時事主已昏迷，隨即送往明愛醫院，延至中午12時41分證實不治。
初步消息指，事主為本地工人，約50歲，當時佩戴安全帶並扣在狗臂架上，在天台棚架工作期間突然連人帶架鬆脫墮下。在場工友即時報警。
勞工處表示正調查此宗致命工業意外。建造業總工會理事長周思傑到場了解後指出，正確做法應將安全帶扣於固定在大廈主體結構的獨立救生繩上，而非狗臂架；舊樓石屎鬆散或批盪過厚，亦可能令爆炸螺絲不夠穩固。
案件列工業意外處理。工權會指今次是本年第19宗建造業死亡事故，亦是與吊棚相關的第2宗。
